description: Push portable calendar JSON: calendar_import_mode create (new calendar) or replace (clear rows on replace_calendar_id, keep same id). Resolves twitter usernames like usecodenaija and NVA_AI to account_id.

calendar_import_mode.description: create = new calendar; replace = wipe rows on replace_calendar_id then re-insert.

calendar_json.description: Stringified JSON bundle from export or hand-authored file.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

publisher_pid.description: Project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

name: import_content_calendar_json
